bespoke.title: Banner preview
bespoke.description: How a banner will look to the care team or on every view.
bespoke.whyNotCatalog: Closest was callout; it previews another screen's banner in that screen's style.

bespoke.title: Brief preview
bespoke.description: A board brief, provider note, governance packet, data request or state summary, with edit, approve, sign or export.
bespoke.whyNotCatalog: No catalog type previews a document with editable sections and export.

bespoke.title: Campaign preview
bespoke.description: The BP campaign: counts by mode, cuffs, top members and standing orders.
bespoke.whyNotCatalog: Closest was action_cards; a campaign needs counts, a member table and its approval state together.

bespoke.title: Campaign progress
bespoke.description: Booked and controlled against the 412, live.
bespoke.whyNotCatalog: Closest was target_bar; two stacked measures on one track that move as the care team works.

bespoke.title: County map
bespoke.description: Nevada county choropleth with layer toggles, frontier places and targeting.
bespoke.whyNotCatalog: Closest was chart; the catalog has no map, and a county choropleth with layer toggles, frontier places and selection needs one.

bespoke.title: County table
bespoke.description: Six counties side by side with heat and suppressed cells.
bespoke.whyNotCatalog: Closest was data_table; heat colouring and suppression marks per cell.

bespoke.title: Drive-time scatter
bespoke.description: Drive time against primary care visits, frontier vs town.
bespoke.whyNotCatalog: The catalog chart draws line and bar only, not scatter.

bespoke.title: Export card
bespoke.description: PDF print view or CSV download of the state summary.
bespoke.whyNotCatalog: Closest was action_cards; no catalog type downloads a file or opens a print view.

bespoke.title: Hand-off cards
bespoke.description: Hand-offs with Approve, shared across personas.
bespoke.whyNotCatalog: Closest was action_cards, which confirms one way; approval here is read by another persona's workbench.

bespoke.title: Key points
bespoke.description: The rest of a step's scripted answer, above catalog visuals.
bespoke.whyNotCatalog: Closest was text; the points need the RAIN bullet style and a synthetic-data label so every screen is labelled.

bespoke.title: Launch card
bespoke.description: Opens a workbench beside the conversation, pre-filtered.
bespoke.whyNotCatalog: No catalog type navigates; CatalogActions has no open-page action.

bespoke.title: Model card
bespoke.description: The impactability model card with its subgroup status.
bespoke.whyNotCatalog: Closest was kpi_table; a model card pairs its fields with a pass or fail subgroup status that changes after sign-off.

bespoke.title: Primary care trend
bespoke.description: Primary care visits indexed to January, the two affected counties against the other four.
bespoke.whyNotCatalog: Closest was chart (line); an index from 86 to 100 needs a fitted axis, which the catalog chart does not offer.

bespoke.title: PMPM trend
bespoke.description: Actual against expected cost per member per month since January.
bespoke.whyNotCatalog: Closest was chart (line); it starts its axis at zero, which flattens a $26 gap on $386, and it has no dashed benchmark line.

bespoke.title: Quality gate tracker
bespoke.description: Five gate measures with current, target, status and optional projection.
bespoke.whyNotCatalog: Closest were kpi_table and target_bar; lower-is-better targets, the gate rule and projection marks on one track have no catalog type.

bespoke.title: Scenario panel
bespoke.description: Do nothing against the three moves, with the timeline to December 31.
bespoke.whyNotCatalog: Closest was chart (bar, two series); each comparison has its own unit and the timeline sits under it, which composed blocks cannot align.

bespoke.title: Segment pyramid
bespoke.description: High-need, impactable and stable members with share of spend.
bespoke.whyNotCatalog: Closest was status_summary; a pyramid of three tiers with spend share and the action per tier has no catalog shape.

bespoke.title: Sign-off
bespoke.description: CIO sign-off and CMO co-sign for a model release.
bespoke.whyNotCatalog: Closest was action_cards; two signatures from two personas gate one release.

bespoke.title: Site comparison

bespoke.whyNotCatalog: Closest was chart (bar); it needs a fitted axis, a reference line, highlighted outliers and selection.

bespoke.title: Task briefing

bespoke.whyNotCatalog: No catalog type for a task queue that opens a workbench.

bespoke.title: Gap waterfall
